title: Fixed Recessed Dial Meter and Twin Probes
description: One newly authored complete static portable multimeter appearance in a flat display pose. A compact protected case has a real blind upper screen well with a recessed opaque blank plate, one broad lower rotary-selector appearance with a raised pointer grip, and three finite annular front sockets. Two of those sockets carry complete fixed plugs and full curved leads; each lead terminates in a long insulated-looking probe grip, shoulder stop and short blunt metal-looking tip. A whole dark perimeter bumper retains the case. All numeric shapes and cable paths newly authored, no game-console casing or controls imported. One prop and zero scenes, three opaque materials; the probes are parts of the complete instrument, not separate assets. No display numbers, calibrated selector range, voltage/current, wiring, measurement performance, live testing, insulation or electrical-safety claim.
